label: Poles as roots of the denominator
section: Poles as roots of the denominator
subgoals: Factor or solve the denominator polynomial
Take the root nearest the origin as the dominant pole
Read the real part as decay and the imaginary part as ringing

label: Stability from pole locations
subgoals: Count poles with a positive real part
Declare the system unstable if any pole lies in the right half-plane

label: Damping from pole positions
subgoals: Compute the natural frequency as the pole's distance from the origin
Divide the pole's decay rate by the natural frequency to get zeta
Relate a smaller zeta to more overshoot
